This endpoint allows renewing an existing authentication token.
When a refresh token is sent, the system checks whether it is still valid and trusted.
On success, it returns a JSON response with the new access token details
and related metadata.
If the token is invalid, expired, or malformed, a structured error is returned.
To renew a token, provide the refresh token via form data.
